Title: Michael Luther and other vote changing cards

Messages.Author: Malcolm Sprye
Messages.Body:
So this came up yesterday. I was under the impression that vote changing cards like Michael Luther/kindred manipulation wouldn't work if the vampire in question had abstained. I was told I was wrong by the people I was playing with. Still, I could have sworn seeing those effects played as aforementioned in a NAC game some years back.

So, can you change the votes of a vampire that has abstained thus far (i.e. has cast no votes)?

Messages.Author: kombainas
Messages.Body:
Only if there is "This can force ... to cast votes"

See justification here www.tomshardware.co.uk/forum/74336-13-distant-friend

Sabbat. If this vampire's bleed is successful, he laughs manicly and untaps.

Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
> Malcolm wrote:
> So, can you change the votes of a vampire that has abstained thus far (i.e. has cast no votes)?
>
Camarilla: You may tap Michael during a referendum to change the votes of a Camarilla vampire to votes of your choice.

No votes =/= "the votes"
i.e. If a vampire abstains, there are no "the votes" to change.

Compare and contrast with Distant Friend:
As above, and you can force the chosen vampire to cast his or her votes when you burn this card.
